title: Elodie and the Cellar
author: Jude Quintana
blurb: Theo Villalobos, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
